seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Gdansk
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Gdansk it currently holds 160 public toilets and 64 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Gdansk has 2.5 times more public toilets than places to refill a bottle — 160 against 64. Worth filling up before you set out.
